summary: This note is a short biographical entry on Javier Garciadiego, a Mexican historian known for his work on the Mexican Revolution. It states that he formerly served as president of El Colegio de México and as director-general of the National Institute of Historical Studies on the Mexican Revolutions (INEHRM). It also notes that he has written several books and holds the 12th seat of the Mexican Academy of History, succeeding the late Beatriz de la Fuente.
one_line: Mexican historian of the Mexican Revolution, former president of El Colegio de México and INEHRM director-general, and holder of a Mexican Academy of History seat.
key_facts: Francisco Javier Garciadiego Dantán was born on 5 September 1951.
Javier Garciadiego is a Mexican historian specialized in the Mexican Revolution.
Javier Garciadiego formerly served as president of El Colegio de México.
Javier Garciadiego is a former director-general of the National Institute of Historical Studies on the Mexican Revolutions (INEHRM).
Javier Garciadiego has authored several books.
Javier Garciadiego holds the 12th seat of the Mexican Academy of History.
Javier Garciadiego substituted the late Beatriz de la Fuente in the 12th seat of the Mexican Academy of History.
